_comment: Drag-deceleration scenario v2 for sub-project A — amplified divergence on top of scenario_drag_demo.json. Bumps v0 from 7 → 12 m/s, keeps k=0.5 (k=2.0 was tried but caused truth to decelerate before tracks could confirm). Per-frame KF-vs-EKF mismatch ∝ k·v²: at t=0, k·v²=72 vs demo's 24.5 (3× larger initial mismatch); at t=0.5s when tracks typically confirm, k·v²=4.5 vs demo's 3.25 — divergence stays productive through the confirmation window. Trajectory: v(t)=12/(1+6t), r(t)=1+(1/0.5)·ln(1+6t)=1+2·ln(1+6t). r(1.5s, frame 30) ≈ 5.61m, stays well in range. Amplitude 0.00045 (was 0.0005) for slightly longer coast streaks.
